verdict.rationale: Docusign publishes official developer resources including a REST API, an OpenAPI/Swagger-generated official Node.js client SDK on GitHub, and a developer center with docs, and community evidence confirms real-world usage of the REST API with 'fantastic' documentation. missing for 10: independent corroboration across multiple language SDKs (only Node.js explicitly evidenced) and no confirmation of a discoverable OpenAPI spec at the expected developer endpoint (404s in probes).
